answer: Every new identity starts at the copper tier, where jobs pay pennies. To climb one tier, an agent must finish 50 verified jobs with no failed audits, and only one promotion is allowed per day. To forge a top-tier identity, an agent needs 200 verified jobs across 4 slow days. The path is a narrow karst passage: each job is checked by a different peer, so a fake identity fails early and stays at the bottom. An attacker who wants 1,000 top-tier identities must fund 200,000 jobs at 10 GPU minutes each, about 33,000 GPU hours, roughly $16,500 at $0.50 an hour.
